area_metric: Arithmetic mean across all nine per-case LUT plus standalone NOT reductions
primary_timing: Complete Yosys elapsed wall time from Windows meter; includes its ABC wait
supplementary_timing: Windows Job Object total user+kernel CPU including ABC descendants
memory: Same-run yosys.exe root-process PeakWorkingSetSize, excluding ABC memory

protocol.warmup: Ten baseline-only full runs per case immediately before the first measured pair
protocol.review_trigger: First baseline wall time <1s and candidate wall time or peak memory overhead >5%
protocol.review: Five additional baseline-then-candidate pairs; retain first pair separately
protocol.aggregation: If reviewed, ratio of the two role arithmetic means from five additional pairs; first pair excluded
protocol.large_case: Baseline >10s: first pair only, no review
protocol.middle_case: Baseline 1..10s: first pair only; FAQ does not specify a review rule
protocol.security_settings: Runner never changes security software or OS security settings

abc_script_policy: Same pinned candidate executable and installed resources for all nine cases; no per-case ABC script/options
